hook.text: We say 'the future lies ahead' and 'the past is behind us.' We think of time as a path.

buildup.text: Conceptual metaphor theory says abstract thinking is grounded in physical experience.

discovery.text: We understand 'more is up' (prices rise), 'affection is warmth' (warm feelings), and 'ideas are objects.'

twist.text: Aymara speakers gesture behind for the future—their time metaphor is reversed.

climax.text: These metaphors aren't universals—they vary across cultures and languages.

punchline.text: We understand the abstract through the concrete.

quiz.question: What does conceptual metaphor theory claim?
options: Abstract thought is grounded in physical experience
